name: dsh-desktop
description: DeepSeek Harness desktop shell: an Electron launcher that runs the dsh web backend (spawned with the system Node) and opens the harness GUI in a native window, with git-managed self-upgrades.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const f of ['progress.html','settings.html']){fs.copyFileSync('src/'+f,'dist/'+f)}"
